criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: IsA
categories.definition: X is a general type or classification of Y.

categories.name: MemberOf
categories.definition: X is a constituent part or member of Y (a larger group, organization, or entity).

categories.name: LocatedIn
categories.definition: X is physically situated within Y (a larger geographical area or structure).

categories.name: OriginOf
categories.definition: X originates from or has its nationality in Y (a place or country).

categories.name: AssociatedWith
categories.definition: X has a general, non-hierarchical, or indirect connection to Y, often involving events, concepts, or activities.

categories.name: CreatedBy
categories.definition: X was brought into existence, designed, composed, or published by Y.

categories.name: HasRole
categories.definition: X holds a specific official position or function Y.

categories.name: FamilyRelation
categories.definition: X and Y are related by family ties.

categories.name: OwnedBy
categories.definition: X is owned, acquired, or controlled by Y.

categories.name: ManufacturedBy
categories.definition: X is produced by Y (a company or brand).

categories.name: CompatibleWith
categories.definition: X can be used with or functions on Y (a system, platform, or software).

categories.name: BroadcastOn
categories.definition: X is shown, distributed, or carried via Y (a media channel or platform).

categories.name: HomeOf
categories.definition: X is the primary location or base for Y (a team, organization, or person).

categories.name: HydrologicalRelation
categories.definition: X is a body of water that flows into, is a tributary of, or is located on Y (another body of water or a related structure like a dam).

categories.name: NamedAfter
categories.definition: X is given its name in honor of or derived from Y.

categories.name: IsAliasOf
categories.definition: X is another name for Y, or Y is now known as X.

categories.name: TimeOfEvent
categories.definition: Y specifies the time or year when event X occurred or was relevant.

categories.name: AwardedTo
categories.definition: X (an award) was given to Y (a recipient).

categories.name: NominatedFor
categories.definition: X (a work or person) was nominated for Y (an award).

categories.name: WonBy
categories.definition: X (an event or award) was won by Y (a participant).

categories.name: IsWrittenIn
categories.definition: X is composed or published in Y (a language).

categories.name: GovernedBy
categories.definition: X (a place or entity) is governed or officially represented by Y (a person or body).

categories.name: PredecessorOf
categories.definition: X came before Y in a sequence, series, or development.

categories.name: ComparedTo
categories.definition: X is being contrasted or compared with Y.

categories.name: PlaysInstrument
categories.definition: X performs using Y (a musical instrument).

categories.name: PlaysSport
categories.definition: X participates in Y (a sport or athletic activity).

categories.name: AdaptationOf
categories.definition: X is a version, remake, or adaptation of Y.

categories.name: CharacterIn
categories.definition: X is a fictional character appearing in Y (a work of fiction).
